notablePrerequisites: Everflowing Chalice has 4 or more charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Everflowing Chalice to add {C}{C}{C}{C} to your mana pool.
Activate Voltaic Key to untap Everflowing Chalice.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers allowing you to copy Voltaic Key's ability and untap Voltaic key with the copy.
Repeat.
